background.note: Uniform per product constraint; depth via border + shadow tokens, not lighter grays

transformation_proposal.rationale: Futura Nota dark (Lumen v0.5) is coherent: deep charcoal gradient (#07090c), document surfaces #151515, mint HUD, coral doc marks. Light tokens (#F1F1F1 / #3D3B3B) exist at :root level but ~350+ component rules still use dark-only white rgba borders and hovers that disappear on light — causing the 'pale' look users reported. Product requires uniform #F1F1F1 (sidebar = canvas = docs) with readable ink details; fullscreen overlays (URL table, export, confirm) stay dark for contrast. Transformation replaces white-rgba drawing with ink-based borders, hovers, and softer elevations; strengthens coral marks for body highlights; keeps dark mode untouched.
